uart.gap: Serial is native USB CDC on the CPU's USB device model (cpu/avr/usb.rs, unit-tested in cpu::avr::usb::tests) and the Arduino matrix row arduino-leonardo prints through it (stock ArduinoCore-avr L0-L7), but that row needs PlatformIO and runs nightly; USART1 (Serial1) has no firmware lane. No PR-gated firmware lane yet.

spi.gap: SPI is the CPU-owned SPCR/SPDR shared with the 328P and the Arduino matrix row arduino-leonardo reads a MAX31855 frame through stock SPI (L4), but that row needs PlatformIO and runs nightly; no PR-gated firmware lane yet.

i2c.gap: TWI is the CPU-owned model shared with the 328P and the Arduino matrix row arduino-leonardo reads an INA219 through stock Wire (L3), but that row needs PlatformIO and runs nightly; no PR-gated firmware lane yet.
